purpose: Intentional PatchNest CLI hardening plus isolated Public1158 compatibility support relative to the pinned KPatch-Next userspace snapshot. The default kpatch target remains Next2026; kpatch-public1158 is a separate build profile with key-authenticated Public1158 semantics and conflicting capabilities such as rehook disabled. PatchNest-Module pins a reviewed source commit for its Public1158 build rather than consuming the historical Next2026 release binary. All other imported source files must remain byte-identical to the pinned upstream commit.
